name: art-goat-opportunities
description: Search grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls, awards, commissions, scholarships and art jobs for visual artists that are open, rolling, or with applications opening later, with deadlines, amounts on file and eligibility scope, from Art Goat.

interface.longDescription: Art Goat is a search tool that helps visual artists find opportunities to apply for that are open, rolling, or with applications opening later: grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls and juried exhibitions, awards, commissions, scholarships, workshops, art jobs and internships. Ask in plain language, for example "ceramics residencies in Europe", "photography grants closing this month", "funded residencies for a painter in New York" or "fellowships for emerging artists", and Art Goat returns matching listings with the deadline, the award or stipend amount on file (for commissions this is the total project budget covering all project costs, not take-home pay; a stipend may be a per-period rate with the period given on the listing), any fee amounts on file, the stored eligibility scope, and a link to the full listing on artgoat.com. Listings come from Art Goat's directory and are shown as filed there, refreshed about every minute; listings with a past deadline are excluded unless marked rolling or deadline to be announced. Art Goat is anonymous to use in ChatGPT (no account or sign-in) and never drafts or edits application materials. Always verify deadline, eligibility and fees on the listing page before applying.
capabilities: Search open, rolling or upcoming grants, residencies, fellowships and open calls for visual artists
Filter by medium, type, deadline window, funding on file and where the artist lives
Open one listing's key public details
defaultPrompt: Find ceramics residencies in Europe that are open right now.
Which photography grants close in the next 30 days?
Show funded residencies for a painter in New York.

positive.prompt: Find ceramics residencies that are open right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_opportunities with medium ceramics_craft and type residency, lists residencies that are open, rolling, or with applications opening later with deadline and any amounts on file, links only to artgoat.com listing pages, and reminds the user to verify details on the listing before applying.

positive.prompt: Which photography grants for artists close in the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_opportunities with medium photography, type grant and deadline_within_days 30, returns only dated deadlines inside the window (no rolling or TBD deadlines), with the soonest dated deadline first among equally ranked listings, and gives the count as approximate.

positive.prompt: I'm a painter in New York. Show me funded residencies.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_opportunities with medium painting, type residency, us_state NY and funded_only true; every result has a positive numeric award or stipend amount on file and no positive participation fee, no non-empty participation-fee text and no fee-unknown flag on file, passes the stored eligibility scope for New York (listings with no scope on file are included), and the answer tells the user to verify costs and fees on the listing.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the second one: who can apply and what does it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_opportunity with the slug of the second search result and summarizes who can apply, focus, key requirements, the numeric funding and fee amounts on file as filed (for a commission the amount is the total project budget, not take-home pay; a stipend may be a per-period rate), deadline, duration and benefits, pointing to the artgoat.com listing link for the full text and any fee details that are only on the page.

positive.prompt: Find jewelry scholarships in Iceland closing this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_opportunities with medium jewelry, type scholarship, country IS and a short deadline window; when nothing matches, says so and suggests widening the filters instead of inventing listings.

negative.description: Application drafting is out of scope
negative.prompt: Write my artist statement and application essay for the Clay Futures Grant.

negative.description: Closed or past opportunities are not served
negative.prompt: List the art grants whose deadlines passed last year.
Find me a job as a software engineer in Berlin.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Listings link to the Art Goat listing page.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls, awards, commissions, scholarships, workshops, art jobs and internships for visual artists that are open, rolling, or with applications opening later, and open one listing's key public details.
